title: Operando Raman spectroscopy for investigating lithium deposition/dissolution and diffusion at the microelectrode surface
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24117-24121
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03080C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hayate Mukofukasawa, Koji Hiraoka, Shiro Seki
Operando Raman spectroscopy was developed to visualize interfacial reactions at a microelectrode, revealing environmental changes during Li deposition/dissolution and enabling analysis of dynamic battery interface processes.
